description: This file contains Odoo module definitions related to HR timesheet invoicing, including classes for invoice rates, analytic accounts, analytic lines, timesheets, and invoices, with methods for calculations, validation, and data manipulation.

classes.name: hr_timesheet_invoice_factor
classes.description: Model representing invoice rate factors with fields for internal name, visible name, and discount factor.

classes.name: account_analytic_account
classes.description: Model extending analytic accounts with invoiced amount calculation, max invoice price, and related fields.

classes.name: account_analytic_line
classes.description: Model extending analytic lines with invoice linkage, validation to prevent modification of invoiced lines, and copy behavior.

classes.name: hr_analytic_timesheet
classes.description: Model extending timesheets with onchange behavior for account ID and copy method.

classes.name: account_invoice
classes.description: Model extending invoices with method to retrieve related analytic lines and adjust 'to_invoice' field based on analytic account settings.

methods.name: _invoiced_calc
methods.description: Calculates total invoiced amount for analytic accounts based on related invoice lines.

methods.name: _check
methods.description: Validates that analytic lines with invoices cannot be modified.

methods.name: on_change_account_id
methods.description: Updates 'to_invoice' field and warns if the analytic account is pending when the account is changed.

methods.name: _get_analytic_lines
methods.description: Retrieves analytic lines for an invoice, setting 'to_invoice' based on analytic account configuration.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of analytic lines or timesheets with 'invoice_id' reset.
